title: Coconut Lime Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and drain.
In a medium saucepan, combine rice, coconut flakes, 1⁄2 cup water, 1 cup coconut milk, and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil then cover and simmer over low heat for 12-15 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Remove from heat and stir in the lime zest and scallions.
sourceNote: Note: This dish is great with chicken satay.
